title: 第四章 冥帝vs卡卡西第五章 初遇宇智波鼬
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
傍晚，吃晚饭的时候，卡卡西，猿飞阿斯玛，月光疾风，夕日红也在。
冥帝一边吃着饭，一边对水门说道"水门老爸，教我忍术！"
"额？"水门皱了皱眉头"进去忍者学校再学也不迟啊！"
"不！我现在就要学。"说着说着，冥帝手指向了卡卡西"看，他那么小就上忍了，肯定也是从小学习忍术的！"
"要不，冥帝明天我教你三身术吧。"月光疾风微微笑道！
"那些忍术，夕日红姐姐已经教过我了。而且我已经学会了。"冥帝说道。什么？这下子猿飞阿斯玛，月光疾风脸色吃惊！
看冥帝才四岁，四岁就学会了三身术？就是卡卡西，水门也是不由得看向了夕日红，夕日红点了点头。
漩涡玖辛奈手靠在了冥帝的肩膀上，对着水门说道"水门，我们的这个儿子可是天才啊！你就亲自教导他忍术吧。"
看漩涡玖辛奈都开口了，水门哪里敢不从？
"好吧！那么你想学习什么级别的忍术呢？"水门看着冥帝，微笑的问道。
"c级！"
"c级？"听到冥帝的话，卡卡西一愣，水门无奈道"你知道吗？老爸和卡卡西都誉为天才，可在你这么小的时候，可没有施展c级忍术相对的查克拉啊！"
"我相信我有！"冥帝一脸肯定！
冥帝从不说谎，这是人人都知道的！这下水门也是用着看妖孽一样的目光打量了冥帝一样！这小子才几岁？就已经有足够查克拉施展c级忍术了？
"你如果不相信，我可以和卡卡西大哥对战一下！"看波风水门和其他人那难以置信的样子，冥帝伸出手指着卡卡西！
卡卡西则是一脸无奈，看向了波风水门！
而波风水门脸色凝重，似乎在思考着什么。
"冥帝！卡卡西大哥很厉害的！而且他比你大了那么多，你才四岁，肯定不是对手。"漩涡玖辛奈拍了拍冥帝的脑袋。
"不！"水门摇了摇头，摸了摸冥帝的头，笑道"冥帝，我一直觉得你很不平凡！既然这样，我就让卡卡西大哥和你练练去。"
猿飞阿斯玛他们都是愣在了那里！

卡卡西，此时已经是上忍了，四岁的冥帝，怎么可能是卡卡西的对手！
而卡卡西看着波风水门的神色，似乎明白了什么，于是点了点头！众人到了小院子里！
"预备...开始！"随着水门的声音落下，卡卡西和冥帝同时投掷出了苦无！
"锵！"两把苦无在空中对撞着擦过。
"不错啊！"看冥帝投掷苦无的准确度和力度，观看的波风水门露出了微笑，就是一般中忍，都难以投掷苦无如此准确！
和卡卡西对战的冥帝知道，自己真的打起来，根本不是卡卡西的对手，而卡卡西对付只有四岁的自己，也一定不会用全力！
如今，冥帝要做的便是防止和卡卡西近身战！冥帝又是投掷出了两把苦无，卡卡西提起手里剑想抵挡下了冥帝的苦无，却又听见两声"锵"的声音，又飞来更为快速的两柄苦无，准确无误的撞在前面两柄苦无的尾部。前面两柄苦无立刻转了个方向，以更快的速度，一上一下朝卡卡西飞去。
这是一个小孩子能做到的苦无技巧吗？
卡卡西脸色从一开始的玩味，已经变得认真。
观看的猿飞阿斯玛，月光疾风等人也是神情凝重了起来。
卡卡西以极快的速度躲过了苦无，可刚刚躲过苦无，对面又是猛然的迎击而来两把手里剑！
怎么这么快？
卡卡西身子又是一动，躲过手里剑！可冥帝的攻势可没有这么简单就结束了！扔出手里剑得到时候，双手结印"操手里剑之术！"
content_en:
In the evening, during dinner, Kakashi, Asuma Sarutobi, Moonlight Hayate, and Kurenai Yuhi were also there.
While eating his meal, Emperor Hades said to Minato, "Dad Minato, teach me ninjutsu!"
"Uh?" Minato frowned, "It's not too late to go to a ninja school and learn more!"
"No! I want to learn it now." As he spoke, Emperor Hades pointed at Kakashi. "Look, he became a jounin at such a young age. He must have been learning ninjutsu since he was a child!"
"How about I teach you the Three Body Technique tomorrow, Emperor Hades?" Moonlight Gale said with a slight smile!
"Sister Yuhi Hong has already taught me those ninjutsu. And I have already learned it." Mingdi said. What? Now Sarutobi Asuma and Moonlight Hayate looked surprised!
Seeing that Emperor Hades was only four years old, he learned the Three Body Technique at the age of four? Even Kakashi and Minato couldn't help but look at Yuhi Kurenai, who nodded.
Uzumaki Kushina put her hand on Hades' shoulder and said to Minato, "Minato, our son is a genius! You should teach him ninjutsu yourself."
Seeing that Uzumaki Kushina has spoken, how dare Minato disobey?
"Okay! So what level of ninjutsu do you want to learn?" Minato looked at Hades and asked with a smile.
"C-level!"
"C-level?" Hearing Hades' words, Kakashi was stunned, and Minato said helplessly, "Did you know? Both dad and Kakashi are known as geniuses, but when you were so young, you didn't have the chakra to perform C-level ninjutsu!"
"I believe I have!" Emperor Hades said with certainty!
Emperor Hades never lies, everyone knows this! This time, Minato looked at Emperor Hades with the same eyes as a monster! How old is this guy? Do you already have enough chakra to perform C-level ninjutsu?
"If you don't believe it, I can fight with Brother Kakashi!" Looking at the unbelievable looks of Minato Namikaze and others, Hades pointed his finger at Kakashi!
Kakashi looked helpless and looked at Namikaze Minato!
Namikaze Minato's face was solemn, as if he was thinking about something.
"Underworld! Brother Kakashi is very powerful! And he is so much older than you. You are only four years old, so you are definitely no match." Uzumaki Kushina patted Hades on the head.
"No!" Minato shook his head, touched Hades' head, and said with a smile, "Hades, I have always thought you are extraordinary! In this case, I will let Brother Kakashi practice with you."
Sarutobi Asuma and the others were all stunned!
Kakashi was already a Jonin at this time. How could the four-year-old Hades be Kakashi's opponent?
Kakashi looked at Namikaze Minato's expression and seemed to understand something, so he nodded! Everyone arrived in the small courtyard!
"Ready...start!" As Minato's voice fell, Kakashi and Hades threw kunai at the same time!
"Qiang!" Two kunai collided and passed by in the air.
"Not bad!" Seeing the accuracy and strength of Hades throwing kunai, Namikaze Minato smiled as he watched. Even ordinary chuunin would find it difficult to throw kunai so accurately!
Hades, who was fighting against Kakashi, knew that if he really fought, he would not be Kakashi's opponent at all, and Kakashi would definitely not use his full strength against himself who was only four years old!
Now, what Emperor Hades has to do is to avoid close combat with Kakashi! Emperor Hades threw two more kunai. Kakashi raised his shuriken to block Emperor Hades' kunai, but he heard two more "clang" sounds, and two more kunai flew faster, hitting the tails of the two kunai in front of him accurately. The two kunai in front immediately turned in a different direction and flew up and down towards Kakashi at a faster speed.
Is this a kunai trick a kid can do?
Kakashi's expression changed from playful at the beginning to serious.
Sarutobi Asuma, Moonlight Hayate and others also looked serious as they watched.
Kakashi dodged the kunai at an extremely fast speed, but just as he dodged the kunai, two shurikens suddenly came from the opposite side!
Why so fast?
Kakashi moved again and dodged the shuriken! But the Underworld Emperor's offensive did not end so easily! When you throw a shuriken and get it, form the seal with both hands "Practice the Shuriken Technique!"
